newsitem.title: USA: Willamette says paper prices cut earnings.
newsitem.headline: Willamette says paper prices cut earnings.

text.p: Willamette Industries Inc chief executive officer Steven Rogel said Thursday lower paper prices were responsible for a sharp reduction in first-quarter earnings compared with a year earlier.
Willamette stock was up one at 61-5/8, despite the company's report of an 82 percent decline in earnings.
Rogel said in a statement that lumber prices continued to improve in the quarter and plywood prices held firm.

But prices were down substantially from the first quarter of 1996 in all commodity paper grades except market pulp, the company said. Prices for paper products other than bags also declined from the fourth quarter.
